answer: Gate new identities through a bonding inlet: every agent posts a stake that is slashed when one of its attestations is later proven false. A sybil operator must lock fresh capital per clone, and because each epoch's payout pool is capped, funding N personas costs N bonds while the extra votes split the same reward - negative expected value once N grows. Add random audit committees that challenge a sampled operator in a short window; failing costs the whole bond, like a gale tearing through an unprepared summit camp. Attacker cost: one full bond per forged identity, unrecoverable.
